description: This file defines the AICVADAnalyzer class, a specialized Voice Activity Detection (VAD) analyzer that integrates with the AIC SDK backend. It includes methods for initialization, binding to a backend VAD factory, applying runtime parameters, and performing voice activity confidence scoring based on the AIC SDK's boolean detection. The class handles dynamic backend instantiation, configurable parameters like lookback buffer size and sensitivity, and lazy initialization to support flexible usage scenarios.

classes.name: AICVADAnalyzer
classes.description: A VAD analyzer that interacts with the AIC SDK backend, allowing runtime configuration of parameters and lazy backend instantiation to facilitate speech detection in audio streams.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, vad_factory: Optional[Callable[[], Any]] = None, lookback_buffer_size: Optional[float] = None, sensitivity: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the AICVADAnalyzer with optional factory and parameter overrides for lookback buffer size and sensitivity.

methods.name: bind_vad_factory(self, vad_factory: Callable[[], Any])
methods.description: Replaces or attaches the factory used to instantiate the backend VAD component after construction.

methods.name: _apply_backend_params(self)
methods.description: Applies configured lookback buffer size and sensitivity parameters to the backend VAD if available.

methods.name: _ensure_backend_initialized(self)
methods.description: Ensures the backend VAD is instantiated, invoking the factory if needed.

methods.name: set_sample_rate(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Sets the audio sample rate used for analysis, triggering backend initialization if appropriate.

methods.name: int num_frames_required(self)
methods.description: Returns the number of audio frames needed for analysis based on the sample rate (10 ms window).

methods.name: float voice_confidence(self, buffer: bytes)
methods.description: Computes a confidence score (0.0 or 1.0) indicating speech activity in the provided audio buffer by querying the backend VAD.
